verdict.rationale: Bruno stores collections, including pre/post-request scripts and tests, as plain-text Bru files on the filesystem, so they can be versioned with Git and reviewed like code. It has a built-in Git UI (init, diff, pull, commit), community users corroborate the plain-text-in-Git workflow, and AI-generated tests and docs can be reviewed before accepting. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of rollback/revert (it is only implied through standard Git, not shown in Bruno's own Git UI), and no automation-specific history or approval workflow beyond generic Git diffs.
